description:
Project Overview

ICIQ invites applications for a fully funded PhD position within its Fully-Funded PhD Programme 2026 – Third Call. The project, "Light-Driven Oscillatory Micromotor Systems" (reference PhD 2026-22 KV), is supervised by Dr. Katherine Villa.

The research focuses on developing micro/nanomotors with autonomous and collective dynamics, using light as an external stimulus to drive oscillatory motion and collective behaviour.

Research position overview

You will design, synthesise, and characterise light-driven micromotors, investigating their individual and collective dynamics. The project combines materials chemistry, nanotechnology, and physical chemistry approaches.

Research Areas

  • Light-driven micromotors and nanomotors
  • Oscillatory dynamics and collective behaviour
  • Autonomous micro/nanosystems
  • Stimuli-responsive materials
  • Micro/nanofabrication and characterisation
